name: Lenses, mirrors and diffusers
summary: Lenses, mirrors, prisms and diffusers from projectors, cameras, scanners and TVs.
uses: Starting fires with sunlight (lenses and concave mirrors)
Magnifiers for fine work and splinters
identify: Big flat Fresnel lenses in rear-projection TVs and overhead projectors; glass lenses in projectors, cameras, binoculars and scanners; mirrors in vehicles, bathrooms and photocopiers; diffusers in LED panels.
test: Focus sunlight on paper: a good lens gives a small bright spot. A big Fresnel lens can start fires and burn eyes in seconds: cover it when not in use.
